description: Choose mobile or home-internet plans, then narrow the complete Comparis.ch offer list with filters and pagination.

connectionType.description: Only plans available over the selected home connection technology.
connectionType.title: Connection type

eSimOnly.description: Keep plans that explicitly support eSIM activation.
eSimOnly.title: eSIM plans only

homeProductSet.description: Which home offers to keep. All includes TV-only and landline-only products as well as internet bundles.
enumTitles: Internet or TV with TV included
Internet or landline with landline included
homeProductSet.title: Home product set

homeProvider.description: Limit home internet, TV or landline plans to one provider. Ignored for mobile plans.
homeProvider.title: Home provider

homeSort.description: Order of the home results before pagination.
homeSort.title: Sort home plans

keyword.description: Optional words that must all appear in the plan name, provider, network, promotion text or product names. Leave empty to browse everything.
keyword.title: Search by keyword

maxContractMonths.description: Skip plans with a longer minimum contract. Use 0 for no limit.
maxContractMonths.title: Maximum contract length (months)

maxItems.description: Maximum records this run writes and the page size used for pagination. The smallest page that still returns data is used as the daily prefill.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxMonthlyPrice.description: Skip plans whose current monthly price (discounted when available) is above this value. Use 0 for no cap.
maxMonthlyPrice.title: Maximum monthly price (CHF)

minDataGb.description: Skip plans below this Swiss data allowance. Unlimited plans always pass. Use 0 for no minimum.
minDataGb.title: Minimum mobile data (GB)

minDownloadSpeedMbps.description: Skip home plans slower than this. Use 0 for no minimum.
minDownloadSpeedMbps.title: Minimum download speed (Mbit/s)

mobileCategory.description: Which mobile plan family to fetch. All combines regular, prepaid, data-only and youth offers for the widest coverage.
mobileCategory.title: Mobile plan category

mobileProvider.description: Limit mobile plans to one provider. Ignored for home plans.
mobileProvider.title: Mobile provider

mobileSort.description: Order of the mobile results before pagination.
mobileSort.title: Sort mobile plans

mode.description: Mobile phone plans or home internet, TV and landline plans. The two legacy values map onto the same modes.
mode.title: What to collect

networkProvider.description: Keep plans that run on one of Switzerland's three physical mobile networks.
networkProvider.title: Swiss mobile network

noMinimumContract.description: Keep only plans without a minimum contract period.
noMinimumContract.title: No minimum contract

only5G.description: Keep plans that support the 5G network.
only5G.title: 5G plans only

onlyDiscountedOffers.description: Keep only plans that currently carry a discounted monthly price.
onlyDiscountedOffers.title: Current promotions only

page.description: 1-based page of the sorted results. Max items also sets the page size; increase page to continue where the previous run stopped.
page.title: Page

roamingEurope.description: Keep plans with any EU roaming data allowance.
roamingEurope.title: Roaming data included

unlimitedCallsCH.description: Keep plans with unlimited calls inside Switzerland.
unlimitedCallsCH.title: Unlimited Swiss calls

unlimitedDataCH.description: Keep plans with unlimited mobile data in Switzerland.
unlimitedDataCH.title: Unlimited Swiss data
